global_constraints.expected_output: Research Intake Package（按协议 §5.3 目录结构）
global_constraints.no_quantity_kpi_note: 本 manifest 刻意不包含 expected_campaign_count 或任何数量目标（协议 §9）。数字只能用于描述覆盖与 Coverage Audit。

global_constraints.campaign_decision: 必须由 ThreeC Agent 走 Research Model v1.0 §5 + Campaign Independence Gate Q1–Q5（research/research/methodology/theme_campaign_separation_v1.md）。
